A और R दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता

questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R): Assertion (A): The Principal is personally accountable for any financial irregularity or loss of government money in the school. Reason (R): As the Drawing and Disbursing Officer, the Principal is bound by the standards of financial propriety and must exercise the same vigilance as a person of ordinary prudence would exercise in respect of their own money.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false

questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A. The Principal is personally accountable for financial losses or irregularities in the school. As the Drawing and Disbursing Officer, the Principal must adhere to the standards of financial propriety, exercising the same degree of vigilance as a person of ordinary prudence would exercise with their own money. This statutory prudence requirement directly explains personal DDO accountability
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। सरकारी धन की हानि या वित्तीय अनियमितता के लिए प्रधानाचार्य जवाबदेह होते हैं, और उन्हें धन खर्च करते समय सामान्य विवेकशील व्यक्ति जैसी सावधानी बरतनी चाहिए।

questions.question_hindi: अप्रैल का मध्य है और विद्यालय को नए वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए बजट आवंटन का आधिकारिक आदेश अभी नहीं मिला है। फिर भी सफाई और सुरक्षा जैसे नियमित काम जारी रहने चाहिए। सरकारी नियमों के तहत इस अंतरिम अवधि के आवश्यक खर्च आमतौर पर कैसे पूरे किए जाते हैं?
options_hindi: विद्यालय प्रमुख निजी बचत से आवश्यक परिचालन खर्च चुकाता है
अंतरिम खर्च लेखानुदान (Vote on Account) या अस्थायी आवंटन के तहत किया जाता है
आधिकारिक आवंटन आदेश आने तक विद्यालय का कामकाज पूरी तरह बंद रखा जाता है
विद्यालय प्रमुख स्थानीय बैंक से आपातकालीन व्यावसायिक ऋण लेता है
questions.question_english: It is mid-April and a school has not yet received its formal budget allocation communication for the new financial year. However, routine operations like sweeping and security must continue. Under government rules, how are such essential expenses typically managed during this interim period?
options_english: The Head of School pays for essential operational expenses out of their personal savings account
Essential interim expenses may be incurred against a Vote on Account or provisional allocation
School operations are completely suspended and closed down until the formal allocation order arrives
The Head of School obtains an emergency commercial loan from a local bank to fund ongoing expenses
questions.explanation_english: Incurred against a ‘Vote on Account’ or provisional allocation. When full budget allocation orders are delayed at the start of a financial year, essential routine expenditures are sustained against a ‘Vote on Account’ or provisional budget allocation passed by the legislature. This legal mechanism authorizes executive spending for interim operational needs, ensuring continuous functioning without personal funding or commercial bank loans
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। अंतरिम अवधि में जरूरी खर्च लेखानुदान या अस्थायी आवंटन के तहत किया जा सकता है; निजी धन या अनधिकृत ऋण का सहारा नहीं लेना चाहिए।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)
